android.desc: In this simulator, you are the Air Traffic Controller at a busy airport. The goal is to guide airplanes safely towards the runway to get a high score. If you make no mistakes, the number of planes in your airspace gets greater and greater. Find out how many flights at a time you can manage! Features • Unlimited amount of planes, multiple runways, • Realistic plane behavior and pilot voices, • Amount of traffic adapts to your skill level, • Customizable traffic flows and scenario mode, • Automatic save function; resume where you left off, • No internet connection required, • No ads. The game is minimalistic, yet realistic. The radar screen may look complicated at first, so there are instructions in-game to point you in the right direction. The game is in English only. This is the Lite version of Endless ATC, which includes one airport. For more airports and options, check out the full version of Endless ATC.

quotes.text: EndlessATC is available for free for Android https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dirgtrats.atcradar&hl=en_GB and apparently for steam as well. It's edging towards the accurate end of the range of ATC games.
